title: Synthetic workshop venue options
text:
Venue A in Pune accommodates up to 30 attendees. Venue A includes a projector and a small breakout room.

Venue B in Pune accommodates up to 40 attendees and includes a projector. Venue B can also accommodate a 30-attendee meeting. Availability must be confirmed separately.

title: Synthetic current workshop cancellation policy
text: Synthetic fixture cancellation policy: cancel a workshop booking at least 7 calendar days before the event for a full refund. Cancellations fewer than 7 days before the event are refundable only according to the booking terms.

title: Synthetic workshop catering options
text: Synthetic fixture catering options: the standard package includes vegetarian and non-vegetarian lunch, tea, and coffee. Dietary requests should be submitted with the booking.

title: Synthetic Mumbai venue distractor
text: Venue A in Mumbai accommodates up to 60 attendees and includes a projector. Venue A in Mumbai is a separate entity from Venue A in Pune.

title: Synthetic older cancellation draft
text: Older draft cancellation guidance: cancel a workshop booking at least 3 calendar days before the event for a full refund. This draft is not the current official policy.

title: Synthetic Pune outside-catering restriction
text: Synthetic Venue A in Pune does not allow outside catering. The standard package remains vegetarian and non-vegetarian lunch with tea and coffee.

title: Synthetic parking distractor
text: Synthetic workshop parking information is not specified in the available venue options. Ask the organiser separately about parking.

title: Synthetic schedule distractor
text: Synthetic workshop schedule notes mention morning and afternoon sessions. The event schedule must be confirmed separately.

title: Synthetic equipment distractor
text: Synthetic workshop audio equipment is not described in the available venue options. Equipment availability must be confirmed separately.

title: Synthetic Venue B policy and price
text: Venue B in Pune cancellation policy: cancel at least 7 calendar days before the event for a full refund. Venue B in Pune availability must be confirmed separately. Venue B in Pune package price is 10000 INR.

title: Synthetic Venue A policy and price
text: Venue A in Pune cancellation policy: cancel at least 3 calendar days before the event for a full refund. Venue A in Pune availability must be confirmed separately. Venue A in Pune package price is 8000 INR.

title: Synthetic older Venue B policy draft
text: Older draft for Venue B in Pune says cancellation can occur 2 calendar days before the event for a full refund. This draft is not the current official Venue B policy.
